articles.summary: Complete Response Letter Received from FDA for BLA Application Based on HARMONi Study Summit Therapeutics Inc. articles.summary: Global Registration-Enabling Study to Evaluate Ivonescimab Versus Durvalumab as Consolidation Therapy Following Concurrent Chemoradiation Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced the initiation of a new global Phase III clinical trial of ivonescimab, an investigational, novel PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody, in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). The study, HARMONi-10, will evaluate ivonescimab compared with durvalumab as consolidation therapy in patients with locally advanced, unresectable Stage III NSCLC who have not experienced disease progression following platinum-based concurrent chemoradiation therapy. Consolidation therapy, given after a patient has responded to initial treatment, aims to deepen or prolong that response and delay or prevent the cancer from coming back or progressing.
